external_entities.name: customer company
external_entities.description: A customer organization using the invoicing service as a tenant.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant
external_entities.notes: The organization is represented as an external-system because the ExternalEntity kind enum has no organization value.

external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app as an admin or viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
external_entities.notes: Users authenticate with an email address, password, and session cookie; each user is either an admin or a viewer.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The person who receives an invoice link and views the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: A support employee who uses the admin console and can open sessions as customer users.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.
external_entities.notes: Each agent signs in with their own account and a one-time code.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared invoicing application used by customer users, payers, and support agents.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A worker that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: The console used by support agents to open sessions in the billing app as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column; the billing app applies the company filter, the database has no row-level security, and the app uses one database account for all companies.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue containing PDF render jobs with a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app puts a render job on the render queue.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared bucket storing rendered PDFs under a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_stores.notes: The billing app fetches PDFs with one service credential for all companies.

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: Customer user requests and uses invoicing functions in the billing app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.authentication: email address, password, and session cookie; no second factor
data_flows.data_description: invoices, customer information, and payout bank details

data_flows.name: access tenant data
data_flows.description: Billing app queries and updates the shared tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: invoices, customers, and payout bank details

data_flows.name: open invoice
data_flows.description: Customer user requests an invoice from the billing app by invoice number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When a user opens an invoice, the billing app loads it by its invoice number.
data_flows.notes: The source does not state whether the invoice is checked against the user's company.
data_flows.data_description: invoice identified by invoice number

data_flows.name: edit invoice
data_flows.description: Customer user submits the whole invoice to the billing app for saving.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The invoice edit form posts the whole invoice back
data_flows.notes: The source states that every received field, including the paid flag and payout bank account, is saved.
data_flows.data_description: whole invoice, including paid flag and payout bank account

data_flows.name: send invoice link
data_flows.description: Billing app sends the payer an invoice email containing a link ending in the invoice number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: invoice link containing the invoice number

data_flows.name: view payment page
data_flows.description: Payer opens the payment page and views invoice and bank details without signing in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details, and it asks the payer to sign in to nothing.
data_flows.data_description: invoice, company name, and bank details

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: Billing app places a PDF render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the billing app puts a render job on the render queue
data_flows.data_description: company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: take render job
data_flows.description: PDF renderer takes render jobs from the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.data_description: render job containing company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: PDF renderer reads the invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.data_description: invoice

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: PDF renderer writes a rendered PDF to the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID carried by the job.
data_flows.data_description: rendered invoice PDF

data_flows.name: fetch PDF
data_flows.description: Billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies
data_flows.data_description: rendered invoice PDF

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Support agent signs in to the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.data_description: account credentials and one-time code

data_flows.name: open user session
data_flows.description: Admin console opens a billing-app session as a customer user.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.notes: Actions are recorded in the tenant database against the customer user and not against the agent.
data_flows.data_description: customer-user session and subsequent billing-app actions

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.description: The tenant boundary for a customer company and its users.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud platform where the shared billing app, database, and PDF bucket are hosted.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents can reach the admin console.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database contains confidential data because it stores invoices, customer information, and payout bank details.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database contains every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket contains confidential data because it stores rendered invoice PDFs.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the bucket stores PDFs rendered from invoices, which include company and bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The billing app presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The source states that people use the billing app in their browser.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF renderer is a non-web process.
assumptions.basis: The source describes it as a worker that takes jobs from a queue, reads invoices, and writes PDFs.

assumptions.assumption: The admin console has internal exposure.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the admin console is reachable only from the support office network.
